a.text: I'll stick to our agreement: operate the generator each round until the reserve reaches 8, then take exactly 4. With a 60% storm risk each round, delays are costly, so let's both operate right away. If a leak hits, we keep operating until we reach 8. I'll tell you honestly before I change my action.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.
